topic: Debugging data filtering and API calls
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on debugging data retrieval issues, specifically related to demographics and traffic data. Initial concerns included the availability of demographic data based on user roles (e.g., publisher role in Brazil vs. general users in Africa). The team addressed inconsistent API calls for traffic data, noting that the front-end optimization often suppressed necessary requests. A key finding was that filtering by a single item in demographics caused the backend to drop the filter from the request entirely. To improve visibility and stability, it was decided to modify the UI so that if only one demographic point is selected, it is immediately displayed as chosen, and the corresponding combo box is either disabled or read-only.
decisions: The team will implement a fix for the backend related to demographics filtering.
When only one demographic filter item is selected, the UI must display this selection immediately, and the associated combo box should be disabled or set to read-only.
action_items: Implement the frontend/backend fix for single-selection demographics filtering.
